text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well… I'm just a little tired.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: As an Umadol who's supposed to give hope to everyone, I know I'm not supposed to let anyone see me looking gloomy…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But at the same time, don't I still look just as cute when I'm sad?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's quite the dilemma… What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Smart Falcon seems to be pretty tired. We might want to reconsider her race schedule.
